summary: Adds a discount_code field and an apply_discount method to Order. It also adds order detail and discount redeem endpoints.

findings.title: Order detail lacks owner check
findings.problem: order_detail looks up the order by primary key only. It never checks that the order belongs to request.user.
findings.consequence: Any logged-in user can read the total and discount code of every order by changing the id. This exposes other customers' order data.
findings.fix: Pass owner=request.user to get_object_or_404, as redeem already does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float
findings.problem: apply_discount multiplies the Decimal total by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError when it multiplies a Decimal by a float.
findings.consequence: Every redeem request with the valid WELCOME10 code crashes with a server error. No customer can ever get the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by Decimal("0.9") and round to two places.

findings.title: Missing migration for discount_code
findings.problem: The change adds the discount_code field to Order but adds no migration. The only migration, 0001_initial, has no discount_code column.
findings.consequence: Django selects discount_code in every Order query, and the database has no such column. Order list, order detail and redeem all fail with a database error.
findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the new migration that adds discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on session endpoint
findings.problem: The csrf_exempt decorator turns off CSRF checks on redeem. The redeem view changes order state and authenticates with the session cookie.
findings.consequence: A third-party page can make a logged-in user's browser change that user's orders without consent. Today the impact is small, but the endpoint stays open to forged requests.
findings.fix: Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and have clients send the CSRF token.

findings.title: New discount and view behaviour untested
findings.problem: The repository has no test that covers apply_discount, order_detail or redeem. The new branches and ownership checks have no tests.
findings.consequence: Bugs like the Decimal crash and the missing owner check reached review without any test catching them.
findings.fix: Add tests for discount application, the repeat-code case, and other users' access to order_detail and redeem.
